MAKE LUNAR GEOMETRY UNDERSTANDABLE.

LOCATE.

Find the observers and understand the geometric question.

COMPARE.

Move one clock, follow transitions, or find a matching sampled run.

VERIFY.

Reopen the exact observation, inspect its source and export a summary.

For educators, the public and technically curious explorers.

Terrain, finite discs, eclipses, power and RF performance are excluded. NASA does not endorse this project. NASA Goddard/LRO imagery and JPL/NSSDCA data are credited in the application. Human owner direction; Codex assisted code, processing, tests and text. No generated imagery or audio.
